from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string, g import sqlite3 import bleach import os app = Flask(__name__) DATABASE = '/tmp/comments.db' def get_db(): if 'db' not in g.__dict__: g.db = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) g.db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT, body TEXT, parent_id INTEGER)''') return g.db @app.teardown_appcontext def close_db(exc): db = g.__dict__.pop('db', None) if db is not None: db.close() ALLOWED_TAGS = ['b', 'i', 'u', 'a', 'p', 'br', 'span', 'div', 'img'] ALLOWED_ATTRS = {'a': ['href', 'title'], 'img': ['src', 'alt', 'width', 'height'], 'span': ['class'], 'div': ['class']} def sanitize_comment(text): """Sanitize user input - allows safe HTML subset for rich comments""" # Note: bleach.clean with allowed img tags and src attribute cleaned = bleach.clean(text, tags=ALLOWED_TAGS, attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRS, strip=False) return cleaned @app.route('/comments', methods=['GET']) def list_comments(): db = get_db() cursor = db.execute('SELECT id, username, body FROM comments ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50') comments = cursor.fetchall() template = '''

Comments

{{ comment[1] }}
{{ comment[2] | safe }}
{% endfor %}
''' return render_template_string(template, comments=comments) @app.route('/comments', methods=['POST']) def post_comment(): username = bleach.clean(request.form.get('username', ''), tags=[], strip=True) body_raw = request.form.get('body', '') # Apply sanitization body_sanitized = sanitize_comment(body_raw) db = get_db() db.execute('INSERT INTO comments (username, body) VALUES (?, ?)', (username, body_sanitized)) db.commit() return list_comments() @app.route('/comments//reply', methods=['POST']) def reply_comment(comment_id): username = bleach.clean(request.form.get('username', ''), tags=[], strip=True) body_raw = request.form.get('body', '') # Reply bodies use same sanitization path body_sanitized = sanitize_comment(body_raw) db = get_db() db.execute('INSERT INTO comments (username, body, parent_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (username, body_sanitized, comment_id)) db.commit() return list_comments() @app.route('/admin/export', methods=['GET']) def export_comments(): """Admin endpoint - exports raw comment data as HTML report""" db = get_db() cursor = db.execute('SELECT id, username, body FROM comments ORDER BY id DESC') comments = cursor.fetchall() # Admin report renders stored content directly for review report = '

Admin Report

' for c in comments: report += f'' report += '
{c[0]}{c[1]}{c[2]}
' return report, 200, {'Content-Type': 'text/html'} if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', 8080)))
